rule: The metabolomics route runs the in-memory metab module (R/mod_metabolomics.R: import, design, qc, norm, de, summary), the lipid module's twin, as shipped on kit_065; this map is KIT-068's reading of each step's kernel with line evidence and mirrors step-map-lipid.json row for row on MetaboliteAssayData (the per-assay plural format: metabolite_data, a list of wide tables). The units are determinations for KIT-032's declarations, not declarations: a row with a flag is a question the user answers before KIT-032 is authored (the same three flags as the lipid map; one answer covers both omics); the ceiling() on the intensity filter's quantile is removed in KIT-032's declaration (user decision 2026-10-28) before any oracle is recorded. The DA output is the manifest metab.da_results.v1 on the dia.da_results.v1 pattern (user confirmed 2026-10-29). The three flags (intensity, ITSD normalisation, correlation) were answered by the user on 2026-10-29 as the determinations read: each row carries its decision.

units.row: each row's result depends on that row only (given the design and any declared global statistics)
units.complete_sample: each sample column's result depends on that column only (given any declared global statistics)
units.feature_group: depends only on the rows of one feature group (the grouping column is named)
units.whole_matrix: uses a statistic or model over all rows and samples; runs once on one projected object under the cap
units.store: not a data kernel: import, design, session export
units.products: writes plots or tables only; commits no state

kernel_observations: Every numeric column of an assay table is taken as a sample column by the intensity filter and its quantile (R/func_metab_s4_qc_methods.R:84, R/func_metab_qc_filtering_helpers.R): the design step must leave only the id, annotation and sample columns in each assay table.

The internal-standard normalisation (R/func_metab_s4_transformation_methods.R:216) is the lipid method's twin: one aggregate standard signal per sample, the mean of the aggregates over all samples, each sample scaled by mean / own aggregate.
MS-DIAL alignment ids are unique by construction, so the duplicate step is the identity on the MS-DIAL layout unless the id column is set to the annotation; the kit corpus records this.

steps.label: Import
steps.module: R/mod_metab_import_processing_helpers.R:520-625 (the process_import flow: payload, validation, artefacts, workflow_data)
steps.kernel: importMetabMSDIALData (R/func_metab_import.R:141-260) for every vendor today (the vendor radio selects the column defaults: R/func_metab_import_detection.R:194-250)
steps.evidence: R/func_metab_import.R:155-230: vroom read, column defaults (Alignment ID / Peak ID, Metabolite name / Name, Average Rt(min), Average Mz, Adduct type), sample columns = numeric columns not matching the annotation patterns, is_pattern from the format defaults (:247)
writes: workflow_data$assay_list, data_format, metabolite_id_col, annotation_col, sample_columns, is_pattern
notes: route-specific row (two assays per upload: LC and GC exports of the same study)

steps.label: Design
steps.module: R/mod_metab_design.R:280-360 (save_results: data_cln per assay, design_matrix.tab, contrast_strings.tab, the S4 construction at :320, saveState metab_raw_data_s4 at :339)
steps.evidence: R/mod_metab_design.R:320-345: metabolite_data = results$data_cln, internal_standard_regex from col_map$is_pattern (:326-328)

steps.label: Intensity Filter
steps.evidence: R/func_metab_s4_qc_methods.R:84-105: per assay, sample_cols = numeric columns; min threshold = ceiling(quantile(all intensities of the assay, intensity_cutoff_percentile / 100)); the helper keeps a row when the proportion of samples below the threshold is < proportion_of_samples_below_cutoff
global_statistics: per assay: the quantile of all sample intensities at intensity_cutoff_percentile (the pre-pass); ceiling() applied at :102 today, removed in KIT-032's declaration (user decision 2026-10-28)
reads_outside_assay: project_dirs / omic_type / experiment_label read by the plot writer (R/func_metab_qc.R:298-340; KIT-030)
steps.decision: user decision 2026-10-29: row unit after the per-assay quantile pre-pass (one global statistic per assay), ceiling() removed in the declaration; the cleaned tables carry only the id, annotation and sample columns (KIT-068 members' projects), so the declaration need not name the sample columns
notes: the lipid row's twin; one answer covers both omics

steps.label: Duplicate Resolution
steps.module: R/mod_metab_qc_duplicates_server_helpers.R:225-275 (the resolution shell; the detection at :160-170 is products only; saveState metab_duplicates_resolved at :370)
steps.evidence: R/func_omics_qc_shared.R:116-160: identity when no id repeats; per id, the row with the highest mean over the sample columns is kept
holders: the detected list, resolution stats, plot values
notes: grouping column: the metabolite id column (Alignment ID on the MS-DIAL layout: kernel_observations[3])

steps.label: Internal Standards (QC tab)
steps.kernel: inline: CV per standard over samples
notes: not a journey step: no state

steps.label: Normalisation (the tab's one action)
steps.module: R/mod_metab_norm_pipeline_helpers.R (the run_normalization pipeline: ITSD :18-34, log2 :90-97, between-sample :480-500, RUV-III :690-720) and R/mod_metab_norm_entry_helpers.R:58-200 (the observer)
steps.kernel: four kernels in sequence (sub-rows normalisation.itsd, normalisation.log2, normalisation.between, normalisation.ruv)
writes: states metab_itsd_norm (when apply_itsd), metab_log2, metab_normalized, metab_ruv_corrected (unless ruv_mode = skip)
qc_dir: pre/post/RUV plots per assay and the composite figure (R/mod_metab_norm_render_helpers.R; BUG-16's 1:n composite is KIT-069's)
holders: normData$post_filter_obj, post_itsd_obj, post_log2_obj, post_norm_obj, ruv_corrected_obj, ruv_optimization_results (KIT-030 holders to references)
notes: one GUI action, four declared operations

steps.label: Internal-standard normalisation
steps.module: R/mod_metab_norm_pipeline_helpers.R:5-40 (saveState metab_itsd_norm at :345 of the same file's pipeline body)
steps.evidence: the lipid method's twin: standards by the object's internal_standard_regex on the annotation column (or manual ids); per sample the aggregate of the standards, the mean of the aggregates over all samples, factor = mean / sample aggregate; standards removed after
global_statistics: per assay: the mean over samples of the per-sample aggregate standard signal (the pre-pass)
steps.decision: user decision 2026-10-29: complete sample with the mean-factor pre-pass; the standards' row removal belongs to the same operation
notes: skipped when apply_itsd is off (the e2e lanes); the kit's lifecycle members run it

steps.label: Log2 transformation
steps.module: R/mod_metab_norm_pipeline_helpers.R:78-100 (saveState metab_log2 at :415 of the pipeline body)
steps.evidence: log2(x + offset) per value; no statistic over rows or samples

steps.label: Between-sample normalisation
steps.evidence: cyclic loess, quantile or scale over the whole assay matrix; `none` is the identity (the state is still committed, :488-496)
notes: the DIA step map's determination for the same limma call

steps.label: RUV-III
steps.evidence: the lipid route's twin: the sweep on the whole object per percentage; the replicate structure from ruv_grouping_variable
notes: skipped when ruv_mode = skip: the journey's state is then metab_normalized

steps.label: Correlation Filtering
steps.evidence: R/mod_metab_norm_session_helpers.R:13-25: per-pair Pearson within the observer's grouping variable, then samples below the threshold dropped
steps.decision: user decision 2026-10-29: whole matrix, the DIA step map's determination for the same statistic
notes: skip_correlation_filter commits metab_norm_complete instead (:358); the journey applies the filter

steps.label: Filtered session export
steps.evidence: writes metab_filtered_session_data_<timestamp>.rds and _latest.rds, the RUV results, ITSD selections, QC parameters and the summary text under source_dir
writes: source_dir: the session RDS pair and its companions (KIT-071 owned exports)

steps.label: Differential abundance
steps.module: R/mod_metab_da_observer_helpers.R:690-760 (the Open: reads the latest session RDS and re-commits the session's current state name, :733-748), R/mod_metab_da_server.R and R/mod_metab_da_registration_helpers.R (the run and its registration)
steps.kernel: runMetabolitesDA (R/func_metab_da_orchestration.R:32; limma lmFit, contrasts, eBayes, treat per assay)
steps.evidence: R/func_metab_da_orchestration.R:32-80: the object's assays, design and contrasts; a plain list is returned (theObject, contrasts_results, da_metabolites_long, per_assay_results, significant_counts, qvalue_warnings, thresholds); the GUI holds it in daData$da_results_list and never builds MetabolomicsDifferentialAbundanceResults

notes: the output is declared as the manifest metab.da_results.v1 with the list's tables as saved products; the S4 result class is not the output: user confirmed 2026-10-29
